lines.en: label dormwarsfive9:
No hands are held on the way to the cafe — nor am I able to strike some sort of balance and secretly kiss Uta as well now that Makoto has gotten hers.
lines.zh: 去咖啡馆的路上没有人牵我的手——我也没能做到某种平衡，趁 Makoto 已经得到她的那份之后，偷偷再亲一下 Uta。

lines.en: But I {i}am{/i} able to zone out.
lines.zh: 但我{i}可以{/i}放空。

lines.en: scene clearnightsky
I’m able to focus on each shining star that slowly shows up in that expansive spring sky.
lines.zh: 我可以专注于每一颗在那片辽阔春日天空中缓缓浮现的、闪亮的星。

lines.en: And it leaves me wondering just how far away they are since I know it takes years for the light to reach us sometimes.
lines.zh: 而那让我不禁好奇它们究竟有多远，因为我知道，有时候光要花上数年才能抵达我们这里。

lines.en: I think of Vega. I’m pretty sure that one was the princess. And how her counterpart never deserved her and is better off on the opposite end of the bird bridge.
lines.zh: 我想起织女。我挺确定那一颗是公主。而她的另一半从来配不上她，他最好就待在鹊桥的另一端别过来。

lines.en: But if there’s anything I know about anything (there’s not), it’s that she might be somewhere else — holding her hand up to the sky the way she always did.
lines.zh: 不过如果我对任何事还有任何了解（其实没有），那就是——她也许在别的什么地方，像她一向做的那样，把手举向天空。

lines.en: And thinking the same thing about me.
lines.zh: 并且想着和我一样的事。

lines.en: Or maybe she already is and I’m just too stubborn to accept it. That sounds plausible too.
lines.zh: 又或者她已经在想了，只是我太固执，不肯接受。那听起来也说得通。

lines.en: scene cafecomedytwo1
Especially when her visage lies ten feet in front of me and I have to fight back against the sun’s gravitational pull to not violently crash into her the way I always want to.
lines.zh: 尤其当她的面容就在我十英尺之外，而我必须对抗太阳的引力，才不会像我一直想做的那样，猛烈地撞上她。

lines.en: I’ll stop soon enough. Maybe even visit the shrine. And maybe I’ll get to a point where I’ll be able to think about her when I’m {i}with{/i} her rather than doing it with others.
lines.zh: 我很快就会停下的。也许还会去一趟神社。也许有一天我能做到，和她{i}在一起{/i}的时候想着她，而不是在别人身边时想着她。

lines.en: That’d be nice, I think. Just sitting on a bench somewhere. Maybe eating takoyaki or whatever else she coerced me into buying her.
lines.zh: 那应该挺好，我想。就坐在某处的长椅上。也许吃着章鱼烧，或者别的什么她缠着我给她买的东西。

lines.en: That aspect of her personality remains the same. I can still feel the sarcasm and desire to drag me around on a leash pouring out of her like carbon dioxide.
lines.zh: 她性格的那一面倒是没变。我依然能感觉到她的刻薄、以及想用绳子牵着我到处走的欲望，像二氧化碳一样从她身上涌出来。

lines.en: Just my memories have become a mask, so they shield me from the byproduct of her loneliness and wind up being lost on me when I close my eyes and pretend I’m lonely too.
lines.zh: 只是我的记忆变成了一张面具，于是它替我挡下了她孤独的副产品，而当我闭上眼睛、假装自己也很孤独时，那些东西就对我失效了。

lines.en: I’m not, though.
lines.zh: 可我并不孤独。

lines.en: I’m just sad.
lines.zh: 我只是难过。

lines.en: scene cafecomedytwo2
: Welp. Guess it’s about time for you to break off from {i}us{/i} and go spend the night with somebody else.
lines.zh: : 好嘞。看来你也该从{i}我们{/i}这儿脱身，去陪别人过夜了。

lines.en: : My money’s on Ami. He started looking for her the moment we walked in.
lines.zh: : 我押 Ami。我们一进门他就开始找她了。

lines.en: : I’m just looking around. For no one in particular. And I’ll probably spend the night with Imani since she’s the only one I can talk to without making someone else jealous.
lines.zh: : 我只是四处看看。没在找谁。而且今晚我大概会陪 Imani，因为只有和她说话不会让别人吃醋。

lines.en: : Imani might be the one we’re {i}most{/i} jealous of. She’s the only one who could make out with you in public without getting you into trouble. That’s the real dream, Sensei.
lines.zh: : Imani 说不定才是我们{i}最{/i}嫉妒的那个。她是唯一一个能在公共场合和你亲热还不害你惹上麻烦的人。那才是真正的梦想啊，Sensei。

lines.en: : You might have to look out for Tsuneyo too if that’s the sole metric you’re using to define your jealousy.
lines.zh: : 如果那是你定义嫉妒的唯一标准，那你大概也得提防 Tsuneyo。

lines.en: scene cafecomedytwo3
: Damn it. I might need to update the ranking at this rate.
lines.zh: : 该死。照这个节奏我可能得更新一下排行榜了。

lines.en: scene cafecomedytwo4
: So! How was it getting to spend a good five minutes “alone” with Sensei without him pushing you away?
lines.zh: : 那么！能和他「独处」整整五分钟、而他还没把你推开，感觉如何？

lines.en: : It was very nice. Thank you.
lines.zh: : 非常好。谢谢。

lines.en: : I still think you should have just sucked him off or something. You’re sneaky enough. You could have managed it.
lines.zh: : 我还是觉得你干脆该给他口一发什么的。你够狡猾的。你本来能做到的。

lines.en: : What’s wrong? Why are you so quiet? This is a good opportunity for us to bond over our greatest mutual interest.
lines.zh: : 怎么了？你怎么这么安静？这可是我们俩就最大的共同爱好增进感情的好机会。

lines.en: : Because I can’t look at you without seeing him. And that doesn’t feel good when you’re always trying to hurt me now.
lines.zh: : 因为我看向你的时候，看到的却只有他。而那并不好受，尤其你现在总是想方设法伤我的心。

lines.en: : Not {i}always,{/i} Maya. I do plenty of nice things for you. Remember?
lines.zh: : 也不是{i}总是{/i}啦，Maya。我也为你做了不少好事啊。记得吗？

lines.en: : Yes, Ami. I remember.
lines.zh: : 记得，Ami。我记得。

lines.en: scene cafecomedytwo5
: I just think I liked you a little more before you were a time-jumping psychopath who tied me to chairs and forced me to orgasm for fun.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得，比起你现在这个会时空跳跃、把我绑在椅子上、为了好玩逼我高潮的精神病，我以前更喜欢你一点。

lines.en: : You kept orgasming {i}after{/i} I untied you too. What’s your excuse there, Maya?
lines.zh: : 我给你解开{i}之后{/i}你还在高潮呢。那个你又有什么借口，Maya？

lines.en: scene cafecomedytwo6
: That I am a shameful pervert who is currently experiencing the largest drought in sexual gratification I have had since I first started fucking your dad.
lines.zh: : 借口就是我是个可耻的变态，目前正在经历自我从和你爸上床以来最严重的一次性满足旱灾。

lines.en: : Fucking my dad {i}how?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}怎么{/i}个上你爸法？

lines.en: scene cafecomedytwo7
: Doggy. Cowgirl. Reverse cowgirl. Whatever it’s called when you do it in the bath. Ekiben. Backwards spider crawl. Even missionary when we’re feeling {i}really{/i} sick.
lines.zh: : 后入式。女上位。反女上位。在浴缸里做的那种叫什么来着。驿便式。倒蜘蛛爬。甚至在我们俩都病得{i}不轻{/i}的时候还会用传教士式。

lines.en: : Maya-
lines.zh: : Maya——

lines.en: : The bicycle. The little dipper. Flatiron. Wheelbarrow. Seated wheelbarrow. The standing dragon. The sideways, slanted flatiron wheelbarrow dragon crawl.
lines.zh: : 自行车式。小北斗式。熨斗式。独轮车式。坐姿独轮车式。立龙式。还有那个侧倾熨斗独轮车龙爬式。

lines.en: : That one isn’t even real.
lines.zh: : 根本没有那种体位。

lines.en: : I don’t know the name of that one. But whatever it was, it felt really good.
lines.zh: : 我不知道那个叫什么。但不管叫什么，感觉真的很好。

lines.en: : You were supposed to just say “behind your back.”
lines.zh: : 你本来只要说「在你背后」就行了。

lines.en: : Oh. Yeah. I was fucking your dad behind your back.
lines.zh: : 哦。对。我是在你背后和你爸上床。

lines.en: scene cafecomedytwo8
: But we’ve already talked about that!
lines.zh: : 可那件事我们已经谈过了！

lines.en: : And you already know I feel bad, so I don’t understand why we’re still stuck on it and not just fucking him together when {i}that{/i} was the original plan.
lines.zh: : 而且你也知道我心里不好受，{i}所以{/i}我不明白为什么我们还卡在这上面，而不是照原计划一起上了他。

lines.en: : You know I’d still prefer to have him all to myself, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道我还是更想独占他，对吧？

lines.en: : Yeah. So would literally everyone else. Which I’m pretty sure is why we were going to join forces in the first place.
lines.zh: : 是啊。其他人也全都想。而我敢说，那正是我们当初要联手的原因。

lines.en: : You really are an interesting one, Maya. I’m actually almost happy you didn’t get reset.
lines.zh: : 你真是个有意思的人，Maya。我甚至差点要为你没有被重置而感到高兴了。

lines.en: : I’m {i}very{/i} happy I didn’t get reset. I’d just be {i}happier{/i} if I was also regularly sleeping with your dad. Which I still intend to do whether you like it or not.
lines.zh: : 我可{i}太{/i}高兴自己没被重置了。只是如果我还能定期和你爸上床，我会{i}更高兴{/i}。而这件事不管你乐不乐意，我都打算继续做下去。

lines.en: : Are you sure that’s something you want to be telling me?
lines.zh: : 你确定这话是该对我说出口的吗？

lines.en: : See, that’s the thing. I don’t really care.
lines.zh: : 你看，问题就在这儿。我其实不在乎。

lines.en: : I love you and I don’t want to hurt you. Just, at the same time, I also love Sensei and I want him to pierce my cervix with his colossal dad-dick.
lines.zh: : 我爱你，我不想伤害你。但同时，我也爱 Sensei，我还想让他用他那根巨大的爸爸鸡巴刺穿我的子宫颈。

lines.en: : God, it’s like your settings are broken by default. It’s so extremely irritating. But also kind of endearing.
lines.zh: : 天啊，你的设定简直像是出厂就坏的。真是烦死人了。但又有那么点讨人喜欢。

lines.en: : Thanks. I’ve always taken a lot of pride in being his secret cock-sleeve.
lines.zh: : 谢谢。我一直都以当他隐秘的鸡巴套子为荣。

lines.en: : So where along the line did you gain {i}feelings?{/i}
lines.zh: : 那你是什么时候开始产生{i}感情{/i}的？

lines.en: : I don’t know. But if you could use your time powers to go back and prevent it from ever happening, I’d appreciate that a lot. Having feelings sucks.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。不过如果你能用你的时间能力回到过去、阻止那件事发生，我会非常感激。有感情真是糟透了。

lines.en: : I don’t have any {i}powers,{/i} Maya.
lines.zh: : 我没有任何{i}能力{/i}，Maya。

lines.en: scene black
: I’m just another regular teenage girl...with the worst luck in the world.
lines.zh: : 我只是个普通的青春期女孩……外加全世界最糟糕的运气。

lines.en: scene cafecomedytwo9
: Hey, Senpai! Wasn’t sure if you were joining us here or not. Glad you did, though. Want a drink? It’s on Haruka as part of the sponsorship deal.
lines.zh: : 嘿，Senpai！不知道你会不会来这儿找我们。不过你来了我很高兴。要喝一杯吗？Haruka 请客，是赞助协议的一部分。

lines.en: : I just ordered one myself. Thanks, though.
lines.zh: : 我自己刚点了一杯。不过谢了。

lines.en: : No problem. Also, do you know what’s going on with Nodoka? I’ve barely heard a word out of her all day.
lines.zh: : 没事。还有，你知道 Nodoka 怎么了吗？我一整天几乎没听她说过一个字。

lines.en: : Which is crazy because she normally has a lot of words and a good portion of them need to be heavily censored.
lines.zh: : 那可真稀奇，因为她平时话多得是，而且其中很大一部分都该被狠狠打码。

lines.en: scene cafecomedytwo10
: Uhh...everything okay, Nodoka? You doing alright?
lines.zh: : 呃……你还好吗，Nodoka？你没事吧？

lines.en: : I think so. I can’t really tell.
lines.zh: : 我觉得还好。我也说不太准。

lines.en: scene cafecomedytwo11
: I have been thinking more about death lately.
lines.zh: : 我最近想死亡想得比较多。

lines.en: : That...does not sound like “alright” to me, Nodoka.
lines.zh: : 那……听起来可不像「没事」啊，Nodoka。

lines.en: : No, I suppose it wouldn’t.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我想也是。

lines.en: scene cafecomedytwo12
: I need to go grocery shopping soon.
lines.zh: : 我很快得去趟超市。

lines.en: : Do you want to field this or should I?
lines.zh: : 你想接这个话还是我来？

lines.en: : I’ll field it. You go do Dorm Wars stuff.
lines.zh: : 我来接。你去忙宿舍战争的事吧。

lines.en: scene cafecomedytwo13
: On it. We were supposed to start soon anyway. Be right back!
lines.zh: : 收到。反正我们也该开始了。马上回来！

lines.en: : Nodoka — look at me.
lines.zh: : Nodoka——看着我。

lines.en: scene cafecomedytwo14
: Did...something happen?
lines.zh: : 是不是……发生了什么？

lines.en: : Yes.
lines.zh: : 是的。

lines.en: : I think my mother told me she loves me.
lines.zh: : 我想我妈妈对我说她爱我了。

lines.en: scene cafecomedytwo15
: Attention, Koi Cafe and girls of 1-A!
lines.zh: : 注意了，Koi Cafe 和 1-A 的姑娘们！

lines.en: : It’s been a long first day of Dorm Wars — but it ain’t over yet!
lines.zh: : 宿舍战争的第一天很漫长——但还没结束！

lines.en: : We’ve got one last competition to hold before sending you all back to the hotel to fend for yourselves for the next 24 hours.
lines.zh: : 在把你们全部送回酒店、让你们自己撑过接下来的二十四小时之前，我们还有最后一场比赛。

lines.en: scene cafecomedytwo16
: But not without first getting to everybody’s favorite part of {i}any{/i} competition — explaining the rules!
lines.zh: : 但在此之前，先要进入{i}任何{/i}比赛里大家最爱的环节——讲解规则！

lines.en: : Yay! Regulations!
lines.zh: : 耶！规章！

lines.en: : No clapping, Yukihime! Regulations on comedy do naught but dilute its potential impact!
lines.zh: : 别鼓掌，Yukihime！喜剧上的规章只会稀释它潜在的冲击力！

lines.en: : You know, after the last time we did that, I figured that you of all people would be in favor of this, Molly.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，在经历了上次那件事之后，我本以为所有人里最该赞成规章的就是你，Molly。

lines.en: : That...oh. Yes. I suppose that...{i}some{/i} regulations might be necessary to prevent anyone else from feeling...horribly disgusting.
lines.zh: : 那个……哦。是的。我想……{i}某些{/i}规章还是有必要的，好防止别人再感到……恶心透顶。

lines.en: : Yay! {i}Some{/i} regulations!
lines.zh: : 耶！{i}某些{/i}规章！

lines.en: : Yes, Yasu! {i}Some{/i} regulations!
lines.zh: : 对，Yasu！{i}某些{/i}规章！

lines.en: scene cafecomedytwo15
: No inappropriate jokes about teacher-student conduct! Because Senpai and I may be hot commodities, but we’re still people! And people have feelings!
lines.zh: : 不许开关于师生关系的不当玩笑！因为 Senpai 和我也许是抢手货，但我们也是人！而人是有感情的！

lines.en: : Crude humor {i}is{/i} fine. But keep in mind that nobody wants to hear about anybody covered in semen.
lines.zh: : 粗俗的幽默{i}可以{/i}。但请记住，没人想听谁被精液糊了一身。

lines.en: : One last rule. Tsuneyo is not allowed anywhere near the microphone.
lines.zh: : 最后一条规则。Tsuneyo 不许靠近麦克风半步。

lines.en: : First, you take my costume. Now, you take my freedom. What is next? My body?
lines.zh: : 先是我的服装，现在又是我的自由。接下来是什么？我的身体？

lines.en: : Aaaand the first rule has already been broken!
lines.zh: : 而……第一条规则已经被打破了！

lines.en: scene cafecomedytwo17
: But let’s just overlook that because now it’s Futaba’s turn and there’s no way {i}she’d{/i} tell any inappropriate jokes! Right, Futaba?!
lines.zh: : 不过我们就当没看见吧，因为现在轮到 Futaba 了，而{i}她{/i}绝不可能讲任何不当的玩笑！对吧，Futaba？！

lines.en: : Futaba?
lines.zh: : Futaba？

lines.en: : Why don’t you just go ahead and introduce yourself? That’s a good way to get the ball rolling, right?
lines.zh: : 你不如先做个自我介绍？那是让事情开始滚动的好办法，对吧？

lines.en: : Hi.
: Futaba.
lines.zh: : Futaba。

lines.en: : That is name.
lines.zh: : 那是名字。

lines.en: : Aight. It appears we may have underestimated the severity of Futaba’s stage fright. So why doesn’t everyone go ahead and cheer her on?! That’ll help, right?!
lines.zh: : 行吧。看来我们可能低估了 Futaba 舞台恐惧症的严重程度。那么大家不如一起给她加油吧？！那会有用的，对吧？！

lines.en: : FUTAAAABAAAAAA!!! I FUCKING LOVE YOUUUUUUUUUUUUU!!!
lines.zh: : FUTAAAABAAAAAA！！！我他妈爱死你啦！！！！！！！！！

lines.en: : YOUR BOOBS RUUUULE!!!
lines.zh: : 你的奶子最棒了！！！

lines.en: : Kirin, come on. That’s totally uncalled for.
lines.zh: : Kirin，别这样。那太过分了。

lines.en: : ALL BOOBS RUUUUUULE!!! GO BOOOOOOBS!
lines.zh: : 所有的奶子都最棒了！！！奶子加油！！！

lines.en: : Oh yeah, that’s way better.
lines.zh: : 哦对，这样说好多了。

lines.en: : This isn’t helping at all, is it?
lines.zh: : 这一点用都没有，是吧？

lines.en: : Boobs.
lines.zh: : 奶子。

lines.en: scene cafecomedytwo18
: Well...it looks like you might not have to work very hard, Touka. Futaba might bomb even worse than Tsuneyo at this rate.
lines.zh: : 嗯……看来你不用太拼命了，Touka。照这个节奏，Futaba 说不定比 Tsuneyo 还砸得厉害。

lines.en: : I still intend to give it my all regardless. It takes a great deal of courage to speak in front of others.
lines.zh: : 不管怎样我还是打算全力以赴。在众人面前讲话需要极大的勇气。

lines.en: : Or at least that’s what I’ve been told. I’ve always found it rather easy, to be completely honest.
lines.zh: : 至少别人是这么告诉我的。说实话，我一直觉得那挺容易的。

lines.en: scene cafecomedytwo19
: Oh, it's totally hard. Like, when I started working at the mall, I could barely even {i}talk{/i} to customers. I couldn’t even imagine having to speak in front of a whole crowd back then.
lines.zh: : 哦，那可难了。比如我刚开始在商场打工的时候，连跟顾客{i}说话{/i}都费劲。那时候我根本无法想象自己要在一大群人面前讲话。

lines.en: : It might be a little easier {i}now{/i} because I’ve been working at the maid cafe for a while. Even still, though. Hard pass.
lines.zh: : {i}现在{/i}可能稍微好一点了，因为我在女仆咖啡厅干了一阵子。但即便如此。打死我也不干。

lines.en: : If I am correct, Ami works at the maid cafe as well. Yes?
lines.zh: : 如果没记错的话，Ami 也在女仆咖啡厅打工。是吧？

lines.en: scene cafecomedytwo20
: Unfortunately, yes.
lines.zh: : 很遗憾，是的。

lines.en: : I take it that you’ve had some...curious interactions with her as well then?
lines.zh: : 那你和她之间……也有过一些奇妙的互动咯？

lines.en: : “Curious” would be putting it nicely. But yes. My dislike for her became pretty intense around the time she started acting like she owned Sensei.
lines.zh: : 「奇妙」算是客气的说法了。不过是的。我开始特别讨厌她，大概就是她开始表现得像 Sensei 是她专属物那阵子。

lines.en: : Unless she’s the one who asked you to ask me about this. In which case, I change my answer to — she’s fine.
lines.zh: : 除非是她让你来问我的。那样的话，我改成——她挺好的。

lines.en: : She did not, no. I just believe that she may have some sort of problem with me based on a conversation we had earlier.
lines.zh: : 她没有。我只是根据我们之前的一次对话，觉得她可能对我有什么意见。

lines.en: scene cafecomedytwo21
: You’re hot. She’s probably just mad that you’ve got double D’s and she doesn’t even have to use a bra yet.
lines.zh: : 你很辣。她大概只是在气你有双 D 罩杯，而她连胸罩都还不用穿。

lines.en: : I do wonder if that’s all it is. I just felt as if her issues were slightly more pointed than breast envy alone.
lines.zh: : 我也在想是不是就只是这个。只是我觉得她的问题，似乎比单纯的胸部嫉妒更尖锐一点。

lines.en: : Could be. Are you in love with her dad by any chance?
lines.zh: : 也许是。顺便问一句，你爱上她爸爸了吗？

lines.en: : Love? Absolutely not.
lines.zh: : 爱？绝对没有。

lines.en: scene cafecomedytwo22
: Yeah. I didn’t think so.
lines.zh: : 嗯。我想也是。

lines.en: : I {i}am{/i} interested in him, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我对他{i}有兴趣{/i}。

lines.en: scene cafecomedytwo23
: ...What?
: I imagine that’s strange to hear given the gap in both our respective ages and...net worths.
lines.zh: : 我想，考虑到我们之间年龄和……净资产上的差距，这听起来大概很奇怪。

lines.en: : And also because I imagine you’re quite intensely “in love” with him as well after nearly strangling Ami when she spoke about him in class.
lines.zh: : 而且大概也因为我想，你在课上听到 Ami 谈论他时差点掐死她，所以你对他也是「深爱」得相当厉害。

lines.en: scene cafecomedytwo24
: Are you going to dislike me too now?
lines.zh: : 那你现在也要讨厌我了吗？

lines.en: : Am I...well...
scene cafecomedytwo25
: Touka, you practically {i}gave{/i} me an apartment. And my sister’s quality of life is, like...{i}way{/i} better now.
lines.zh: : Touka，你基本上等于{i}送了{/i}我一套公寓。而我妹妹的生活质量现在，比如……{i}好太多{/i}了。

lines.en: : So it’ll take more than you just...{i}being interested{/i} in Sensei for me to dislike you.
lines.zh: : 所以要让我讨厌你，光是「{i}对 Sensei 有兴趣{/i}」可不够。

lines.en: : I see.
lines.zh: : 我明白了。

lines.en: : And what if I were to sleep with him?
lines.zh: : 那如果我真和他上了床呢？

lines.en: scene cafecomedytwo26
: Touka, I’d really prefer it if we don’t talk about this. I’m trying to not get involved in anyone’s romances but my own now.
lines.zh: : Touka，我真希望我们别谈这个。我现在只想不掺和别人的恋情，只管我自己的。

lines.en: : Doing the opposite is just...too painful.
lines.zh: : 反着来……太痛了。

lines.en: scene cafecomedytwo27
: I completely understand and wholeheartedly apologize if that seemed crass of me. I don’t intend to ruin or disrupt any pre-existing relationship Sensei is involved in.
lines.zh: : 我完全理解，如果我刚才显得粗俗，我由衷道歉。我无意破坏或扰乱 Sensei 已有的任何一段关系。

lines.en: scene cafecomedytwo28
: This is likely just a hormonal issue on my end. I don’t mean to alarm you.
lines.zh: : 这大概只是我单方面的荷尔蒙问题。我无意让你惊慌。

lines.en: : Hormonal?
lines.zh: : 荷尔蒙？

lines.en: scene cafecomedytwo29
: Then, and this is purely hypothetical, do you think these feelings might go away if you {i}did{/i} sleep with him?
lines.zh: : 那么，纯粹假设一下，你觉得如果你{i}真{/i}和他上了床，这些感觉会消失吗？

lines.en: : ...I’m sorry what?
lines.zh: : ……抱歉你说什么？

lines.en: : Like...and again, {i}totally{/i} hypothetical, but say the three of us all got naked together and had sex in the same room-
lines.zh: : 比如……再说一次，{i}完全{/i}假设，假如我们三个一起脱光，在同一个房间里做爱——

lines.en: : Chika, what has happened to you?
lines.zh: : Chika，你到底怎么了？

lines.en: : Nothing. I’m normal.
lines.zh: : 没什么。我很正常。

lines.en: : You don’t sound very normal right now.
lines.zh: : 你现在听起来一点也不正常。

lines.en: : I’m totally normal and this is totally hypothetical. But you should still totally answer the question. Hypothetically, of course.
lines.zh: : 我完全正常，这也完全是假设。不过你还是完全该回答那个问题。当然是假设性地。

lines.en: : Hm.
scene cafecomedytwo30
: Hypothetically?
lines.zh: : 假设性地？

lines.en: : Then...
lines.zh: : 那么……

lines.en: : Perhaps.
lines.zh: : 也许吧。

lines.en: : Entirely hypothetically, of course.
lines.zh: : 当然，完全是假设。

lines.en: : Oh yeah. Entirely. Which is why I’m definitely not going to hypothetically remember or hypothetically try and arrange it.
lines.zh: : 哦对。完全是。所以我肯定不会假设性地记住，也不会假设性地去安排。

lines.en: : Please hypothetically don’t.
lines.zh: : 请假设性地不要。

lines.en: : I’m actually not sure anymore as this conversation is bordering on the line of unintelligibility.
lines.zh: : 我现在真的不确定了，因为这段对话已经濒临无法理解的边缘。

lines.en: : Regardless, we should likely cease as it appears that Futaba is finally ready to begin.
lines.zh: : 不管怎样，我们大概该停了，因为 Futaba 好像终于准备开始了。

lines.en: scene black
: I completely and hypothetically agree.
lines.zh: : 我完全、假设性地同意。

lines.en: : So you...don’t agree?
lines.zh: : 所以你……不同意？

lines.en: : I’m also not really sure what’s going on anymore.
lines.zh: : 我也不太确定现在在发生什么了。

lines.en: scene cafecomedytwo31
: So, umm...hi.
lines.zh: : 那，呃……大家好。

lines.en: : That...that part isn’t a joke.
lines.zh: : 那……那部分不是笑话。

lines.en: scene cafecomedytwo32
: And t...to be com...pletely honest...there might not be {i}any{/i} jokes while I’m up here because the...only joke I...thought up was just...me.
lines.zh: : 而且说……说实话……我上台期间可能{i}一个{/i}笑话都没有，因为我……唯一想出来的笑话就是……我自己。

lines.en: : Boooo! No self-deprecating humor! You are cherished and loved by all!
lines.zh: : 嘘——！不许自嘲式幽默！你是被所有人珍视和爱着的！

lines.en: : ESPECIALLY ME! FUTABA RULES!
lines.zh: : 尤其是我！FUTABA 最棒了！

lines.en: scene cafecomedytwo33
: Thank you, Rin...
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，Rin……

lines.en: scene cafecomedytwo34
: Y...You know...Rin and I...have known each other for years now! And throughout that time, we’ve...been through a lot together...
lines.zh: : 你……你们知道……Rin 和我……已经认识好多年了！在那段时间里，我们……一起经历了很多……

lines.en: : Some highs...some lows...some...things we probably shouldn’t talk about...
lines.zh: : 有高潮……有低谷……有些……我们大概不该提的事……

lines.en: : But I think the...thing I’ll always remember the most is...uhm...
lines.zh: : 但我想我……最永远不会忘记的是……呃……

lines.en: scene cafecomedytwo35
: The time we accidentally shoplifted from FamilyMart and thought the police were going to find us and...lock us away for life.
lines.zh: : 那次我们不小心在 FamilyMart 顺了东西，以为警察会找上门、把我们……关一辈子。

lines.en: : And when I say “we,” I...mostly mean me. Because, as I’m...sure you all know, I’m...not exactly the most {i}exciting{/i} person out there.
lines.zh: : 而我说「我们」，其实……主要指的是我。因为，正如你们……都知道的，我……算不上是多{i}令人兴奋{/i}的人。

lines.en: : I don’t break rules often. And that’s probably because I’m too busy...breaking chairs from...sitting on-
lines.zh: : 我不常打破规则。那大概是因为我太忙着……把椅子坐——

lines.en: scene cafecomedytwo36
: Okay, seriously — stop. I tried to be playful about it the first time, but if you use this mic to stand up here and trash yourself, I’m actually going to suspend you.
lines.zh: : 好了，认真的——停。第一次我想用玩笑的方式带过，但如果你拿着这个麦克风站在这儿贬低自己，我是真的要让你停学。

lines.en: : But...Miss Imai...there are lots of comedians who...tell jokes about themselves to-
lines.zh: : 可是……Imai 老师……有很多喜剧演员都……拿自己开玩笑来着——

lines.en: : Yeah. {i}Jokes.{/i} Would you laugh if I came up here and talked about the way I look for an entire set, Futaba? Knowing what you know about me — would you laugh at that?
lines.zh: : 对。是{i}玩笑{/i}。如果我上台来，整场都讲我的长相，你会笑吗，Futaba？以你对我的了解——你会觉得好笑吗？

lines.en: : I...no...of course not...
lines.zh: : 我……不会……当然不会……

lines.en: : Then don’t subject the people who love {i}you{/i} to that same thing. Do you understand?
lines.zh: : 那就别让爱{i}你{/i}的人承受同样的事。明白吗？

lines.en: scene cafecomedytwo37
: Yes, Miss Imai...
lines.zh: : 明白了，Imai 老师……

lines.en: : If you can’t believe in yourself, believe in the people who do.
lines.zh: : 如果你没法相信自己，那就相信那些相信你的人。

lines.en: : You got this.
lines.zh: : 你可以的。

lines.en: scene cafecomedytwo38
: {i}Ahem!{/i} Sorry about that, folks! Little technical difficulty. Nothing to be concerned about. Futaba — if you’d like to proceed.
lines.zh: : {i}咳咳{/i}！抱歉，各位！一点小小的技术故障。没什么好担心的。Futaba——请继续。

lines.en: : So...um...uhh...
scene cafecomedytwo39
: What’s the deal with airline food?!
lines.zh: : 飞机餐到底是怎么回事啊？！

lines.en: scene cafecomedytwo40
: Sorry about that, Senpai. I- oh. I leave for one second and you bag Nodoka. Fun.
lines.zh: : 抱歉啊，Senpai。我——哦。我才走开一秒，你就把 Nodoka 搞到手了。真有你的。

lines.en: : I didn’t {i}bag{/i} her. She’s just...tired, I think.
lines.zh: : 我没把她{i}搞到手{/i}。她只是……累了，我想。

lines.en: : Tired and...{i}not{/i} suicidal.
lines.zh: : 累了，而且……{i}不会{/i}自杀。

lines.en: scene cafecomedytwo41
: I don’t think you have to worry about Nodoka doing something like that. She has too much left to contribute to society to kill herself.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你不用担心 Nodoka 会做那种事。她对社会还有太多可以贡献的东西，不会去自杀。

lines.en: : Yeah, so did Robin Williams and Anthony Bourdain and look what happened to them.
lines.zh: : 是啊，Robin Williams 和 Anthony Bourdain 也一样，你看看他们后来怎么样了。

lines.en: : True, but Nodoka doesn’t have depression.
lines.zh: : 没错，可 Nodoka 没有抑郁症。

lines.en: : Are you a psychologist now? She was literally just talking about a death fascination a few minutes ago.
lines.zh: : 你现在是心理学家了？几分钟前她还在那儿大谈对死亡的着迷呢。

lines.en: : Yes. But while you were gone, she told me something else. Something she doesn’t want me repeating back to you.
lines.zh: : 是的。但你不在的时候，她还告诉了我别的事。一件她不希望我转述给你的事。

lines.en: : And that something is enough for you to think she’s okay and not in any immediate danger?
lines.zh: : 而那件事就足以让你觉得她没事、没有迫在眉睫的危险？

lines.en: : None that doesn’t come from just lying on me.
lines.zh: : 除了躺在我身上这件事以外，没有别的危险。

lines.en: scene cafecomedytwo42
: Okay, Senpai. If you say so. You know her better than I do.
lines.zh: : 好吧，Senpai。你说什么都行。你比我了解她。

lines.en: : Would you mind working your magic on Futaba next, though? I’m seriously going to break if I hear that girl say one more bad thing about herself.
lines.zh: : 不过你介意接下来对 Futaba 也施施你的魔法吗？我如果再听那女孩说自己一句坏话，我真的要崩溃了。

lines.en: : I’ve been trying to “work my magic” on her for years now and I’ve gotten nowhere. I think she’s just immune to it.
lines.zh: : 我试着对她「施魔法」好几年了，一点进展都没有。我想她就是对这免疫。

lines.en: : Perfect. Another adolescent girl who grows up hating herself because of the way she looks. I’m sure that won’t have any long term negative impact on her.
lines.zh: : 完美。又一个因为自己的长相而长成自我厌恶的青春期女孩。我敢肯定那不会对她的长期发展有任何负面影响。

lines.en: : Or she’ll grow up to be an accomplished, beautiful woman who’s a complete joy to be around and also very good at sex.
lines.zh: : 或者她会成长为一个有成就的、美丽的女人，和她在一起非常愉快，而且床上功夫也很好。

lines.en: scene cafecomedytwo43
: Aww, Senpai. That’s really cute and nice of you. But also extremely creepy because you’re talking about a student.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，Senpai。你说话真贴心、真可爱。但也极其变态，因为你说的是一名学生。

lines.en: : Yeah, I immediately regretted saying all of that.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我刚说完就后悔了。

lines.en: scene black
Futaba’s set doesn’t last much longer. She mostly just retells jokes she’s heard from other comedians.
lines.zh: Futaba 的表演没持续多久。她基本上只是在复述她从别的喜剧演员那儿听来的段子。

lines.en: And while it sucks for her that her original plan went up in flames at the hands of a woman who likes her too much, I {i}do{/i} think it’s what was best for everyone.
lines.zh: 虽然对她来说，原定计划被一个太喜欢她的女人烧成灰烬很可惜，但我{i}确实{/i}认为那对所有人都是最好的结果。

lines.en: It’s just...really depressing.
lines.zh: : 只是……真的很压抑。

lines.en: scene cafecomedytwo44
But now Touka’s on stage and there’s no way she can be as miserable as that.
lines.zh: 不过现在 Touka 上台了，她绝不可能像刚才那么悲惨。

lines.en: : Class of 1-A! Hello and thank you {i}so{/i} much for having me.
lines.zh: : 1-A 班的各位！大家好，{i}非常{/i}感谢你们邀请我来。

lines.en: : It’s both an honor and and absolute delight to come up on the same stage that’s seen the likes of several {i}amazing{/i} comedians like-
lines.zh: : 能站在这个曾见证过好几位{i}了不起的{/i}喜剧演员的舞台上，我既感到荣幸，也感到无比欣喜，比如——

lines.en: scene cafecomedytwo45
: Approximately thirty seconds of Ayane and...fifteen seconds of Tsuneyo the last time we did this?...
lines.zh: : 上次我们办这个的时候，Ayane 大概撑了三十秒，还有……Tsuneyo 十五秒？……

lines.en: scene cafecomedytwo44
: But I suppose that doesn’t matter! After all, stand-up comedy {i}is{/i} difficult.
lines.zh: : 不过我想那不重要！毕竟，单口喜剧{i}是{/i}很难的。

lines.en: : And I imagine standing up is difficult in general when you spend as much time with Sensei as Ayane does.
lines.zh: : 而我猜，如果像 Ayane 那样花那么多时间和 Sensei 待在一起，连站起来本身都很难。

lines.en: : Touka-
lines.zh: : Touka——

lines.en: scene cafecomedytwo46
: Aaah! Yes, yes — {i}rules and regulations.{/i} Something we all know Miss Imai is overly familiar with.
lines.zh: : 啊啊！对，对——{i}规则和规章{/i}。我们都知道 Imai 老师对这东西再熟悉不过了。

lines.en: : Just like {i}I’m{/i} overly familiar with my checkbook and {i}Sensei{/i} is overly familiar with...
lines.zh: : 就像{i}我{/i}对我的支票本再熟悉不过，而 {i}Sensei{/i} 对……

lines.en: scene cafecomedytwo47
: Cleaning his sheets, I hope?
lines.zh: : 我希望是换床单？

lines.en: scene cafecomedytwo48
: Knowing him, though — chances are he leaves that to his beloved Ami! Who, contrary to popular belief, is actually a very nice girl!
lines.zh: : 不过以我对他的了解——他大概会把那活儿留给他心爱的 Ami！而她，与大众的印象相反，其实是个非常好的女孩！

lines.en: : In fact, just earlier today, she had the courtesy to tell me she {i}admired{/i} how I’ve never had to work for anything in my life!
lines.zh: : 事实上，就在今天早些时候，她还很有礼貌地告诉我，她很{i}羡慕{/i}我这辈子从来不需要为任何东西努力过！

lines.en: : Which I may have been initially offended by, I’ll admit.
lines.zh: : 这点我承认，一开始我确实有点被冒犯。

lines.en: : {size=-3}But, after thinking about it a little more, I realized there’s probably no one {i}more{/i} familiar with doing nothing than a girl who thinks it’s somehow difficult to care for a man whose only interests are...{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-3}但再多想一会儿之后，我意识到，大概没有谁比一个认为照顾一个男人是件困难的女孩，更熟悉「什么都不做」这件事了——而那个男人的兴趣只有……{/size}

lines.en: : See, I don’t even know. What are Sensei’s interests, Ami? Could you tell us, please?
lines.zh: : 你看，我连那都不知道。Sensei 的兴趣是什么，Ami？请你告诉我们好吗？

lines.en: scene cafecomedytwo49
: Right! He doesn’t have any.
lines.zh: : 对！他没有任何兴趣。

lines.en: : {size=-3}But still — I understand your plight and how slaving over a hot stove for an hour each day is likely much harder than the ten hours of classes I take {i}after{/i} school while you forget to do your freshman algebra homework.{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-3}不过话说回来——我理解你的苦衷，每天在滚烫的炉子前忙活一小时，很可能比我放学后还要上的十小时课要难多了，而你连高一代数作业都忘了写。{/size}

lines.en: scene cafecomedytwo50
: I’m not {i}only{/i} here to talk about Ami, though. Which I’m sure you’re all {i}very{/i} excited to hear given that barely any of you even want to talk {i}to{/i} her now.
lines.zh: : 不过我今天来不{i}只是{/i}为了聊 Ami。我猜你们听到这个都{i}很{/i}兴奋，毕竟现在你们里几乎没一个人还想{i}跟{/i}她说话。

lines.en: : So instead! Let’s talk about her {i}dad.{/i} Let’s talk about Sensei.
lines.zh: : 那么改个话题！我们来聊聊她{i}爸爸{/i}。我们来聊聊 Sensei。

lines.en: scene cafecomedytwo51
: Do you know what he told me recently? That I’m like a {i}mother{/i} to him. Can you believe that? A {i}mother.{/i} I didn’t even know Sensei {i}had{/i} a mother.
lines.zh: : 你们知道他最近跟我说了什么吗？他说我就像他的{i}母亲{/i}一样。你们能相信吗？{i}母亲{/i}。我都不知道 Sensei 还{i}有{/i}个母亲。

lines.en: : I assumed he was some sort of alien life form or government experiment based on how everyone seems to fall for him for no reason whatsoever.
lines.zh: : 我还以为他是某种外星生命体，或者政府实验品，毕竟所有人似乎都会毫无理由地爱上他。

lines.en: : Even {i}Io{/i} likes him. {i}Yumi{/i} likes him. And I imagine {i}Yasu{/i} likes him too, but I haven’t fully learned how to speak her language yet and can’t ask her.
lines.zh: : 连 {i}Io{/i} 都喜欢他。{i}Yumi{/i} 也喜欢他。我猜 {i}Yasu{/i} 也喜欢他，不过我还没完全学会说她的语言，所以没法问她。

lines.en: : I’ll let you know when I do, though. In fact, right this very moment, I have her taking part in a comprehensive course on expression that- what’s that? She’s right behind me?
lines.zh: : 等我学会了会告诉你们的。事实上，就在此刻，我正让她参加一门关于表情表达的综合课程——什么？她就在我身后？

lines.en: : Damn. Touka ain’t half bad.
lines.zh: : 靠。Touka 还真不赖。

lines.en: : Oh! Thank you so much for weighing in, Kirin! Everyone knows just how much the rest of the girls in our class look to you for guidance.
lines.zh: : 哦！非常感谢你的点评，Kirin！大家都知道，我们班其他女生有多么仰仗你的指引。

lines.en: : In fact, you were one of the first people I started learning from after I transferred in. Which is probably why I’m revealing so much skin right now.
lines.zh: : 事实上，我转学过来之后最早开始学习的人里就有你。这大概就是我现在露这么多皮肤的原因。

lines.en: scene cafecomedytwo52
: A job well done then.
lines.zh: : 那我干得不错。

lines.en: : Words she’s never heard from her parents.
lines.zh: : 这句话她可从没从她父母嘴里听到过。

lines.en: : And {i}now{/i} I’m sad.
lines.zh: : 而{i}现在{/i}我难过了。

lines.en: scene cafecomedytwo53
: Girls, Sensei — I imagine you all came here today expecting both of us to completely bomb.
lines.zh: : 姑娘们，Sensei——我猜你们今天来这儿，都预期我们俩会彻底搞砸。

lines.en: : And given the objectivity of comedy, I suppose that some of you may believe I {i}have.{/i}
lines.zh: : 而鉴于喜剧的客观性，我想你们中有些人可能认为我{i}已经{/i}搞砸了。

lines.en: : But to me, comedy is more than {i}just{/i} telling jokes. It is commentary on the world. Or a subject. Or anything that brings people together.
lines.zh: : 但对我来说，喜剧不{i}只是{/i}讲笑话。它是对世界的评论。或者对某个议题。或者任何能把人聚在一起的东西。

lines.en: : And that’s the point of Dorm Wars too, isn’t it? To unite the class in ways in which we normally wouldn’t?
lines.zh: : 那也是宿舍战争的意义所在，不是吗？以我们平时不会有的方式，把全班团结起来？

lines.en: : Or am I just still not getting this whole {i}commoner{/i} thing and the point really {i}is{/i} just fighting for Sensei’s approval?
lines.zh: : 还是说我到头来还是没弄懂这个「{i}平民{/i}」的玩意儿，真正的意义其实就只{i}是{/i}争夺 Sensei 的青睐？

lines.en: scene cafecomedytwo54
: If that {i}is{/i} the point, fine.
lines.zh: : 如果那真{i}是{/i}意义所在，好。

lines.en: : If that really {i}is{/i} the point, I ask you all to kindly forget every single thing I said up here today. Except for one.
lines.zh: : 如果那真的就{i}是{/i}意义所在，那么我恳请各位，忘掉我今天在这儿说过的每一句话。除了一句。

lines.en: : The part where {i}that guy{/i} over there said he sees me like a mom.
lines.zh: : 就是那边{i}那个家伙{/i}说，他把我看作妈妈的那句。

lines.en: : And how fucking weird that will make him if he ever bangs me.
lines.zh: : 以及如果他哪天真上了我，那会有多他妈的变态。

lines.en: scene black
scene cafecomedytwo55
: Well...that went better than last time at least. Which isn’t saying the bar was set all that high.
lines.zh: : 嗯……至少比上次好。虽然那根标杆本来也没设多高。

lines.en: scene cafecomedytwo56
: But even if I have {i}several{/i} issues with Touka’s performance, I will acknowledge that her set made me feel exponentially less bad than Futaba’s did.
lines.zh: : 不过就算我对 Touka 的表现有{i}诸多{/i}意见，我得承认她的段子让我感觉比 Futaba 的好太多了。

lines.en: : I could also not, in good faith, give Futaba the win because half of her jokes were pulled straight from the mouth of Jerry Seinfeld.
lines.zh: : 而且我也不能问心无愧地把胜利给 Futaba，因为她有一半的段子是直接从 Jerry Seinfeld 嘴里搬来的。

lines.en: : Sooooo...Touka?
lines.zh: : 所以……是 Touka？

lines.en: scene cafecomedytwo57
: Yes. Touka wins. But-
lines.zh: : 是的。Touka 赢。不过——

lines.en: scene cafecomedytwo58
: Splendid! Thank you all so much for listening to me speak!
lines.zh: : 太好了！非常感谢大家听我说话！

lines.en: scene black
: And Sensei...
lines.zh: : 还有 Sensei……

lines.en: scene cafecomedytwo59
: Keep your {i}daughter{/i} on a tighter leash or I will tie one to her neck myself.
lines.zh: : 把你{i}女儿{/i}的绳子拴紧点，不然我就亲自给她脖子上系一根。

lines.en: scene cafecomedytwo60
: Holy shit.
lines.zh: : 我操。
